div.div: انت بِمُنْتَزَحٍ مِنْ كَذَا (tropical:) Thou art far removed from such a thing; (S, K *;) and, by poetic licence, بِمُنْتَزَاحٍ, with أَلِف إِشْبَاع. (S.) Ex. أَنْتَ مِنَ الدَّمِّ بِمُنْتَزَحٍ (tropical:) Thou art far removed from blame. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
